verdict.rationale: Hummingbird documents adding file attachments to a case's Files tab as evidence, a case Comments section for notes (exported as case comments in history reports), and an automatic audit trail of all work. Capturing decision reasons as a distinct, structured part of the investigation history is only implied by marketing copy about keeping decisions defensible. missing for 10: explicit documentation of recording decision or disposition reasons, a documented unified investigation-history timeline tying evidence, notes and decisions together, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can record evidence, notes and decision reasons in the investigation history

citations.quote: You can add one or more attachments (bulk import) in the Files tab from within a case
This will download case data for the time frame selected, including case comments.
Automatic audit trail: This feature ensures that you have comprehensive audits of all work that occurs in Hummingbird.
